title: Antastulu
desc: An extremely disciplined zamindar who expects everyone in his family to be equally obsessed about it, faces challenges when his younger son rebels.

title: Amma Rajyam Lo Kadapa Biddalu
desc: After becoming the chief minister, Jagannadh Reddy works tirelessly for the welfare of the people. However, his enemies leave no stone unturned to sabotage his authority.

title: Yuddham Sharanam
desc: When the corpses of his parents are found in a river under mysterious circumstances, Arjun sets out to investigate their deaths. On finding certain disturbing truths, he vows revenge on their killers.

title: Chandamama Kathalu
desc: Saradhi is a writer whose child is chronically ill. He writes an anthology of seven stories which he intends to sell to raise money for his child's treatment.
